title: MIN (SQL) | InterSystems SQL Reference | InterSystems IRIS Data Platform 2026.1

examples.sql: SELECT '$' || MIN(Salary) AS LowSalary FROM Sample.Employee
SELECT MIN(Salary) FROM Sample.Employee WHERE Home_State = 'VT'
SELECT Home_State, COUNT(Home_State) As NumEmployees, MIN(Salary) As LowSalary FROM Sample.Employee GROUP BY Home_State ORDER BY LowSalary

SELECT Home_State, '$' || MIN(Salary %AFTERHAVING) AS MinSalaryAbove75K, '$' || MIN(Salary) AS MinSalary, '$' || MAX(Salary) AS MaxSalary FROM Sample.Employee GROUP BY Home_State HAVING Salary > 75000 ORDER BY MinSalaryAbove75K
